title: Telemetry quickstart: compact latency / cost / tracecards screenshots
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Design and export a compact set of quickstart UX assets for the Console Observability flows focusing on: latency overview, cost-per-token breakdown, and lightweight trace micro-views ("tracecards"). Deliverables: desktop + mobile screenshots with annotations and hover/focus states, compact and expanded cost-card variants, tracecard mockups that fit inside the quickstart panel, redlines (spacing, typography), color token mapping for engineering, alt text + copy snippets for docs, and export-ready PNG/SVG at 2x. Coordinate metric names and SLO thresholds with ENG; finalize export paths and add to docs PR.
